entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I'm just so disappointed. I bought this new VeloBand GPS tracker, and the pulse reader is completely inaccurate. It's basically garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your new VeloBand. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the pulse reader, or a preference issue with how the data is displayed?
It's a fault. A big one. It says my heart rate is 50 when I'm jogging. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've never had a product this bad. I honestly don't have time to deal with this.

I understand your frustration completely. An inaccurate reading like that would be very concerning. I can definitely look into this. Would you be open to trying a quick reset with me? Sometimes a software calibration can fix that right up.

No, I'm sorry, I just can't. I don't have time for troubleshooting. I've already wasted enough time on this. I just want my money back. A full refund, please. I really needed that money for something else this month.
I see. I know this is the last thing you want to deal with. Let me just pull up your account and our return policy to see what we can do. Can I have your order number?
Sure, it's VF886-21. I hope this can be resolved. I've always trusted VeloFit.

Thank you. Okay, I see your account. You're a VIP member, Mr. Harris, thank you for being with us for so long. I'm just checking the policy... one moment... Okay, I see here that your item was delivered 24 days ago. And our knowledge base states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you're well within that window.
I've gone ahead and approved that return for a full refund for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box and drop it off.
Oh! Really? That's... that's wonderful. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

Of course, Mr. Harris. We value your loyalty. As a token of our apology for the trouble, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been fantastic. Thank you again!
